title: money_approved lifts the paid-session stub for a refused gate (answer no) and for any gate whose text holds spent or paid, since it tests only that an answer exists and a money word
goal: bl_dispatch.money_approved counts a gate as approving spend only when its answer equals one of the gate's options, that option is not a refusal (its first word is no, refuse, decline, deny, reject or cancel, in any case), and the gate's question alone (not its options or its other fields) names a money signal in bl_authority.strict_signals; a gate answered no, an answer that is none of the options, or a question with no money signal leaves the paid-session stub in place

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_dispatch as d;it={"gates":[{"id":"g1","question":"Spend USD 5 on a paid smoke test?","options":["yes","no"],"answer":"no"}]};sys.exit(1 if d.money_approved(it) else 0)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_dispatch as d
def g(a, q="Spend USD 5 on a paid smoke test?", opts=("yes", "no")):
    return {"gates": [{"id": "g1", "question": q, "options": list(opts), "answer": a}]}
cases = [
    d.money_approved(g("yes")) is True,
    d.money_approved(g("no")) is False,
    d.money_approved(g("Decline")) is False,
    d.money_approved(g("maybe")) is False,
    d.money_approved(g("yes", "Which helper name for the stub?")) is False,
    d.money_approved(g("approve USD 5", "Which helper name for the stub?", ("approve USD 5", "decline"))) is False,
    d.money_approved(g("approve USD 5", "Spend on the smoke test?", ("approve USD 5", "decline"))) is True,
]
print(cases)
sys.exit(0 if all(cases) else 1)

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, types, pathlib
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_dispatch as d
r = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", str(r)], check=True)
it = {"gates": [{"id": "g1", "question": "Spend USD 5 on a paid smoke test?", "options": ["yes", "no"], "answer": "no"}]}
bl = types.SimpleNamespace(root=r, items={"BG-aaaaaaaa": it})
env = d.guard_spend(bl, "BG-aaaaaaaa", {"PATH": "/usr/bin"})
first = env["PATH"].split(os.pathsep)[0]
sys.exit(0 if first.endswith(d.STUB_DIR_NAME) else 1)
